title: Vallee's 1985 CIA document on staged abductions in Argentina and Brazil

tellings.quote: The document is a description of CIA operations in Argentina and Brazil to abduct peasants so that they think they're being abducted by aliens for its quote, I'm quoting psychological warfare value.
go look up this this reference that Jock File's document from the CIA has it black and white says we're conducting the abductions,
tellings.difference: This telling has the document saying the abductions are carried out globally, not only in Argentina and Brazil, and gives no date.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the CIA document credited to Jacques Vallée saying the CIA staged alien abductions using humans.

as_told.title: CIA document says abductions are conducted by humans globally

plain: The claim is that a 1985 CIA document describes the agency abducting peasants in Argentina and Brazil so that they would believe aliens had taken them, for what Greer quotes as its "psychological warfare value." A UFO researcher named Steven Greer tells this, saying the document appears in a 1992 book, a journal, by Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and UFO researcher, and he also names the former Army officer John B. Alexander. Later in the same talk he calls it a CIA document from a man named Jock File that says "black and white" that "we're conducting the abductions," this time with no place and no date, which would mean some alien abduction stories are staged by people.
